findings.summary: reset_mlflow_autolog_and_traces fixture uses get_traces().clear() which only clears a local list, not the backend trace store — dead code masquerading as cleanup (former conftest called purge_traces() which actually deleted traces)
findings.failure_scenario: While the root tracking_uri_mock fixture provides per-test database isolation today, get_traces().clear() is a no-op on the backend. If the isolation mechanism is ever changed or removed, traces will leak between tests, causing len(get_traces()) == 1 assertions to fail when stale traces from prior tests accumulate.

findings.summary: skip_when_testing_trace_sdk changed from pytest.mark.skipif (collection-time skip, fixtures do not run) to runtime pytest.skip() in a wrapper (fixtures execute before skip), causing autouse fixture side-effects to fire unnecessarily for skipped tests
findings.failure_scenario: When IS_TRACING_SDK_ONLY is True, any test decorated with @skip_when_testing_trace_sdk will now run its autouse fixtures (e.g. tracking_uri_mock creating temp databases, reset_autolog_state mutating globals) before the skip fires — wasting CI time and risking fixture side-effects that the old skipif mark avoided by skipping at collection time.
